Create Job Script:Custom Script - A script has a tag attribute, indicating that it is a high-risk script. When creating such script, you do not need to perform secondary verification on whether it is high-risk. - Perform tenant isolation. If the approver field is not set for the script created by the northbound interface, the script does not need to be approved by default. - Constraints: - Script name: In the same tenant, the script name must be unique. It can contain a maximum of 64 characters, including letters, digits, and underscores (_). - The maximum size of the script is 100 KB. - The maximum number of script parameters is 20. - Script description: a maximum of 256 characters. - The name of a single parameter consists of 64 characters, including letters, digits, and underscores (_). - The value of a single parameter contains a maximum of 1024 characters. The regular expression is ^((?!\.{2,})[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\/\.\*\x20\?:",=+@\\\[\{\]\}])*$. - A maximum of five approvers are supported. - The total size of logs generated by the script is 1 MB.

Obtain the batching result based on the batching policy. Only automatic batching is supported. The rules are as follows: 1. All instances in a batch must belong to the same region. * 2. All instances in a batch must belong to the same AZ. * 3. All instances in a batch must belong to the same application. * 4. The number of instances in the same group in a single batch does not exceed 50%. (except when there is only one instance in grouping); * 5. The number of nodes in each of the first three batches cannot exceed 10. * 6. The number of instances in each batch cannot exceed 10. The total number of machines is 200.

Modifying Job Scripts: Custom Scripts Constraints: Script Name: The script name under the same tenant must be unique. It contains a maximum of 64 characters, including letters, digits, and underscores (_). The script content can contain a maximum of 4096 characters. A maximum of 20 script parameters are supported. Script Description: Enter a maximum of 256 characters. The name of a single parameter contains 64 characters, including only letters, digits, and underscores (_). The value of a single parameter can contain a maximum of 1024 characters. The regular expression is ^((?!.{2,})[a-zA-Z0-9_-/.*\x20?:",=+@\[{]}])*$. If the modified script has a reviewer, you need to select reviewers again after the modification.
